description:
Late in the second period, Brock Nelson rips a perfectly placed wrist shot past the goaltender, finding the back of the net for what stands as the eventual game-winner against the Kings. In his first full season with Colorado, Nelson continues to prove his value down the middle, providing stability and offense as a reliable presence at center.

description:
Logging the most ice time per game among Ottawa Senators skaters in each of the past three seasons, Jake Sanderson has become a trusted presence in every situation. The dynamic defenseman puts his skating and defensive instincts on full display in a tight third period against the New Jersey Devils. After a turnover off a blocked shot sends the Devils the other way, Sanderson explodes from a standstill on the far side, tracking back from behind the play and blowing past everyone to break up the scoring chance—drawing a roar from the home crowd for his relentless effort. He led all skaters with 26:09 of ice time in the game, finishing +2 with an assist.

description:
A player defined by his leadership and relentless compete level, Nick Suzuki puts it all on display against the Colorado Avalanche. With Colorado on the power play, the puck is cleared high into the neutral zone where Suzuki tracks it down to spring a breakaway. In alone on the netminder, he sells the shot, pulls it to his backhand, and tucks it home for a shorthanded strike—his second goal of the night. It’s another statement performance from Suzuki, who has now led the Canadiens in scoring for five straight seasons, driving the team’s steady rise over that span.
